settings.title: Settings
settings.helpLangNote: Corrections, tips and translations use this language.

models.licenses: All models are open source (Apache-2.0 or MIT).

models.sec.asr.note: Turns your speech into text, on the device.
models.sec.voice.note: The American voices that talk to you.
models.sec.help.note: Lets you say something in your own language when you're stuck; ASound shows how to say it in English.
models.diskFull: Not enough free space for this download.
